#include <string>
#include <regex>

int main() {
    string s;
    getline(cin, s);
    
    regex pattern("(?<=([\\s\\S]))(?!\\1)");
    sregex_token_iterator iter(s.begin(), s.end(), pattern, -1);
    sregex_token_iterator end;
    
    int count = 0;
    for (; iter != end; ++iter) {
        string run = iter->str();
        if ((run.length() & 1) == 0) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    
    cout << count << endl;
    return 0;
}
